source: 805 Test
target: 805 Experimentum

source: Lez didn’t ask why.
target: Lez non rogavit cur.

source: He went upstairs, found a piece of red cloth, and hung it at the entrance of the Carnivore bar.
target: Ascendit, pannum rubrum invenit, et ad ostium tabernae Carnivorae suspendit.

source: Lumian then sat at the newly rebuilt bar, enjoying the spiced, marinated roast beef with soft, delicious bread.
target: Lumian tunc ad tabernam nuper refectam consedit, gaudens degustare carnem bovis assam, conditam et marinatam, cum pane molli et delicato.

source: As time passed, more and more customers entered the Carnivore bar.
target: Tempore procedente, magis ac magis clientes in tabernam Carnivorae intraverunt.

source: Lez had put up a wooden stand outside with a new menu and corresponding prices.
target: Lez extra posuit stativum ligneum cum novo menu et pretiis congruentibus.

source: Of course, this wasn’t the main reason for the influx of customers.
target: Certe, hoc non erat principalis causa influxus clientium.

source: The primary reason was the incredibly low prices on the menu.
target: Causa primaria erant pretia in menu incredibiliter humilia.

source: After all, there was no owner to take a cut.
target: Post omnia, nullus dominus erat qui partem acciperet.

source: The customers came in with a sense of skepticism.
target: Clientes cum sensu dubitationis intraverunt.

source: They didn’t have much faith in the bar under new ownership, repeatedly checking if the prices were real, if there were any hidden costs, and if the portions and quality of the food were as advertised.
target: Non multam fidem habebant in taberna sub nova potestate, iterumque atque iterum perscrutantes an pretia vera essent, an expensa occulta haberentur, et an portiones atque qualitas cibi iuxta praeconata essent.

source: This skepticism stemmed from being frequently deceived by Morora’s unscrupulous merchants.
target: Haec dubitatio orta est ex eo quod saepe mercatoribus Mororae sine scrupulo decepti erant.

source: Those merchants had a point, though: “We’ve been exiled here for serious crimes.
target: Illi mercatores tamen habebant rationem: “Exsuli sumus hic propter crimina gravia.

source: You can’t expect us to run honest businesses, can you?
target: Non potes exspectare ut negotia honesta curemus, nonne?

source: Besides, the Morora Resident Code doesn’t prohibit false pricing or inferior goods, and the enforcers won’t check the kitchen’s hygiene.”
target: Praeterea, Codex Incolarum Mororae non vetat falsam praevaluationem neque bona inferiora, et custodes hygienam culinae non inspiciunt.”

source: Most customers were angry but helpless.
target: Plurimi clientes irati erant sed impotentes.

source: Those merchants they could deal with had already been eliminated.
target: Mercatores, quibus tractare poterant, iam exstincti erant.

source: The remaining ones were too powerful to confront.
target: Reliqui nimis potentes erant ad eos oppugnandos.

source: They often regretted not keeping a few manageable merchants around to ensure food quality and fair pricing through regular supervision.
target: Saepe paenitebant quod paucos mercatores tractabiles non retinuerunt, qui curarent qualitatem cibi et pretia aequa per regularis vigilantiam.

source: Sometimes, killing wasn’t the best solution.
target: Aliquando, interficere non erat optima solutio.

source: “If I had understood that, I wouldn’t have been exiled to Morora!”
target: “Si id intellexeram, in Morora non exsul essem!”

source: A man in his forties voiced his opinion while holding a beer with white foam.
target: Vir in annis quadragenariis suam sententiam dixerat, tenens cervisiam cum spuma alba.

source: His gaze kept shifting to Julie, temporarily acting as the bartender, hoping to catch her attention with his words and demeanor.
target: Aspectus eius iterum atque iterum ad Julie vertebatur, quae pro tempore caupo agebat, sperans verba et habitum suum ad eam allicere.

source: Low prices drew them in, but the pretty bartender made them stay for another drink.
target: Pretia humilia eos attraxerunt, sed pulchra caupona eos ad alium potum manere fecit.

source: Lumian forked a piece of perfectly roasted beef, savoring the combination of Lez’s secret spices and the tender meat.
target: Lumian partem carnis bovis assae perfecte coctae arripuit, fruens coniunctionem specierum secretarum Lez et teneri carnis.

source: He wondered if, after leaving Morora, he should have Ludwig become a head chef.
target: Cogitavit num, postquam Mororam relinqueret, Ludwig caput coquinae fieret.

source: Can’t waste a Chef’s talent!
target: Ingenium coqui non spreandum est!

source: After finishing lunch, Lumian took a glass of strong liquor and walked around the hall as the bar owner, piecing together the current situation in Morora from different customers.
target: Postquam prandium finitum habuit, Lumian vitrem liquoris validi cepit et per atrium, tamquam dominus tabernae, ambulavit, ex diversis clientibus condicionem Mororae contexens.

source: Not long after the establishment of this City of Exiles, a class division emerged, mainly based on power.
target: Non longe post institutionem huius Urbis Exsulorum, divisio classium orta est, praesertim ex potentia.

source: Today, the Beyonders firmly controlled all key positions in Morora, holding the resources like food, meat, vegetables, dairy products, various minerals, factory goods, sales channels, and street shops.
target: Hodie, Beyonderes firmiter omnes positiones clavis in Morora imperabant, tenentes opes ut cibum, carnes, olera, producta lactea, varia mineralia, merces fabricarum, canales venditionis, et tabernas viarias.

source: Ordinary criminals without supernatural powers could only serve them, working on farms, in mines, ranches, factories, etc.
target: Criminales vulgares, sine viribus supernaturalis, eis solum inservire poterant, operantes in agris, in fodinis, in praediis, in officiis, etc.

source: The better-off were employees; the worse-off were nearly slaves.
target: Meliores erant operarii; inferiores fere servi erant.

source: For these ordinary criminals, the ultimate dream was to gain the trust of a powerful Beyonder and receive unwanted Beyonder characteristics as rewards after a duel.
target: Pro his criminalibus vulgariis, ultimus somnium erat fiduciam potentis Beyonderis adipisci atque proprietates indesideratas Beyonderis, ut praemia post certamen acciperent.

source: This is exactly what the Iron and Blood Cross Order dreamed of, Lumian mused with a chuckle after returning to his seat at the bar.
target: Hoc ipsud est quod Ordo Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis somniavit, inquit Lumian subridens postquam ad sedem suam in taberna rediit.

source: As a former member of the Iron and Blood Cross Order, he often mocked the awkward “preaching” and “rituals,” but it helped him grasp the core ideology of the Iron and Blood Cross Order:
target: Ut pristinus membrum Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis, saepe deridebat ineptam praedicationem et ritus, sed id eum adiuvabat ut nucleum ideologicum Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis caperet.

source: They wanted to establish a world where Beyonders no longer hid but gained status through power.
target: Volebant mundum instituere, in quo Beyonderes non iam latebant sed per potentiam statum adipiscebant.

source: Morora seemed to embody this vision.
target: Morora videbatur hanc visionem incarnare.

source: Lumian was about to finish his drink and find a quiet place upstairs to study when he noticed Gusain, the gentleman, entering the bar.
target: Lumian iam potionem finire parabat et quietum locum in superiore qua studeret quaerebat, cum notavit Gusain, virum urbanum, tabernam intrantem.

source: You came quickly…
target: Celeriter venisti…

source: Someone’s been watching this place?
target: Aliquisne hunc locum observavit?

source: Lumian played with his glass.
target: Lumian vitrem suum luserat.

source: Gusain sat beside him, removed his top hat, and addressed Julie, who wore a white blouse, black vest, and a dark tie with a unique charm, “A Lanti Proof.”
target: Gusain iuxta eum consedit, pileum superiorem sustraxit, et ad Julie, quae albam tunicam, atrum vestem, et obscurum nodum cum singulari venustate gerebat, locutus est: “A Lanti Proof.”

source: In Morora, the most popular drinks were rye beer, Lanti Proof, and red wine.
target: In Morora, potiones maxime populares erant cervisia secalis, Lanti Proof, et vinum rubrum.

source: Lumian took out paper and pen from his Traveler’s Bag and started sketching on the bar counter.
target: Lumian ex sacculo viatoris chartam et calamum extraxit, et in mensa tabernae delineare coepit.

source: Gusain waited until Julie handed him the Lanti Proof, took a sip, and then smiled ahead.
target: Gusain exspectavit donec Julie ei Lanti Proof tradidit, sorbuit, et deinde subridens prospexit.

source: “You made your decision faster than I expected.”
target: “Celerius decrevistī quam ego exspectābam.”

source: “I don’t want to be tied down like this,” Lumian replied with a hidden meaning—his true intention was that he didn’t want to stay in Morora long, while Gusain interpreted it as him not wanting to remain under the Church of Knowledge’s rule.
target: “Nolo me tali modo vincire,” respondit Lumian, subnubiliter indicans se non velle diu in Morora manere, dum Gusain id interpretavit ut non velle sub regimine Ecclesiae Cognitionis manere.

source: “That’s a choice all strong people make.
target: “Illa electio est quam omnes fortes faciunt.

source: Eagles don’t mingle with sparrows,” Gusain praised.
target: “Aquilae cum passeribus non miscuntur,” laudavit Gusain.

source: Lumian, still sketching, laughed.
target: Lumian, adhuc delineans, risit.

source: “Now, you need to convince me that you have a promising future.
target: “Nunc, oportet me convincere te futurum promissum habere.

source: I won’t stand with losers.”
target: Non stabo cum perditoribus.

source: “I’ve incited dozens of riots and haven’t been caught by the Church of Knowledge.
target: “Dozenas tumultus excitavi, et a Ecclesia Cognitionis non comprehensus sum.

source: Isn’t that reason enough?” Gusain sipped his Lanti Proof.
target: “Nonne hoc iam satis est?” Gusain Lanti Proof sorbuit.

source: Lumian shook his head.
target: Lumian caput concussit.

source: “In my hometown, there’s a saying, ‘One swallow doesn’t make a summer.’
target: “In patria mea, dicitur: “Una hirundo non facit ver.”

source: It means that a single event can’t predict a season.
target: Id significat unum eventum non posse totam aetatem praedicere.

source: Making hasty judgments based on isolated incidents is unwise.”
target: Festinanter ex casibus isolatis iudicare imprudens est.

source: “What do you need to be convinced?” Gusain tilted his head.
target: “Quid tibi opus est ut convincaris?” Gusain caput inclinavit.

source: Lumian chuckled in response.
target: Lumian subridens respondit.

source: “Pass my test.”
target: “Supera probationem meam.”

source: Gusain paused for a moment, then laughed.
target: Gusain paulisper cessavit, deinde risit.

source: “Normally, wouldn’t it be our organization testing new members to see if they’re qualified?
target: Normaliter, num non solet nostra organizatione novos membra probare, ut videat an idonei sint?

source: How did it become the other way around?”
target: Quomodo conversum est?

source: “It depends on the new member’s strength and importance, not past experiences,” Lumian said, with an expression suggesting he didn’t need them to stir up trouble—he could form his own team.
target: “Hoc pendet ex viribus et momentis novi membri, non ex priscis experimentis,” inquit Lumian, vultu indicante se non eos ad tumultum excitandum require, sed suam ipsam turmam constituere posse.

source: Gusain drank his Lanti Proof, then said, “What do you want us to do?”
target: Gusain Lanti Proof sorbuit, deinde dixit: “Quid vis ut faciamus?”

source: Lumian remained silent until he finished his sketch, then pushed the paper toward Gusain.
target: Lumian silentium retinuit usque ad finem delineationis, deinde chartam ad Gusain protraxit.

source: “Find this person.”
target: “Invenias hunc.”

source: The drawing was of Albus Medici.
target: Delineatio erat de Albo Medici.

source: Although Lumian’s drawing skills weren’t high, his precise control as a Hunter, his deep memory of the subject, and mental reconstruction made Albus Medici’s likeness vivid, capturing his aggressive, unpleasant aura.
target: Quamquam ars delineandi Lumiani non alta erat, eius accurata disciplina venatoria, memoria profunda rei, atque reconstructio mentis effecit ut imago Albi Medici vivesceret, exprimens eius aerem aggressivum et incommodum.

source: “Him?” Gusain asked, confirming as he held the drawing.
target: “Eum?” inquit Gusain, confirmans, dum delineationem tenebat.

source: Lumian nodded slightly.
target: Lumian leviter annuit.

source: “His real name is Albus Medici. I don’t know if he’s using an alias in Morora.”
target: “Nomen verum eius est Albus Medici; nescio an in Morora nomine aliquo uterit.”

source: “Medici…” Gusain repeated the last name softly.
target: “Medici…” repetivit Gusain leniter.

source: He folded the drawing, tucked it into his pocket, then picked up his drink.
target: Delineationem plicavit, eam in sinum recondidit, deinde potionem assumpsit.

source: “You can test us, but we need to test you too.
target: “Nos probare potes, sed te quoque probare oportet.

source: You must prove your capabilities.”
target: Debes facultates tuas probare.

source: “Killing the original owner of this bar isn’t enough?” Lumian smiled.
target: “Interficere dominum originarium huius tabernae non sufficit?” subridit Lumian.

source: “Or do you want to duel me?”
target: “An me certare vis?”

source: Gusain, maintaining his gentlemanly demeanor, shook his head.
target: Gusain, urbane se gerens, caput concussit.

source: “We acknowledge your strength. Now we need to test other aspects.”
target: “Agnoscimus tuam potentiam. Nunc oportet nos alias res probare.”

source: Lumian, holding his glass, turned to Gusain, waiting for him to elaborate.
target: Lumian, vitrem tenens, ad Gusain se vertit, exspectans ut amplius explicaret.

source: Gusain glanced around, his eyes resting on the irresistibly charming Julie for a moment.
target: Gusain circumspiciens, oculis per momentum in Julie quievantibus, mansit.

source: Lowering his voice, he said, “The Church of Knowledge’s control over Morora relies on something in the underground mausoleum of the cemetery.
target: Vox suam leniorem faciens, inquit: “Dominatio Ecclesiae Cognitionis super Mororam innititur quadam re in subterraneo mausoleo coemeterii.

source: Our ultimate goal is to break in and take control of it.”
target: Propositum nostrum ultimum est irrumpere et imperium eius capere.”

source: “It’s very dangerous.
target: “Valde periculosum est.

source: We found a similar place to train our members.
target: Similem locum invenimus ad exercendum membra nostra.

source: Your test is to enter that fog‐covered underground area, overcome the challenges, and reach the marked location.”
target: Probatio tua est ingredere illam regionem subterraneam caligine obductam, provocationes superare, et ad locum signatum pervenire.

source: The goal is still 0-01?
target: Num finis adhuc 0-01 est?

source: Lumian thought for a few seconds and said, “Alright, when do we start?”
target: Lumian aliquot secundis cogitavit et dixit: “Bene, quando incipiemus?”

source: “Tonight,” Gussin finished his Lanti Proof, paid, and left the Carnivore bar.
target: “Hac nocte,” finivit Gussin Lanti Proof, solvit, et tabernam Carnivoram discessit.

source: Lumian glanced at Julie, noticing she was dealing with customers politely and reservedly, seemingly unaware of his conversation with Gusain.
target: Lumian Julie aspiciebat, animadvertens eam clientes comiter et circumspecte tractare, quasi sermonem eius cum Gusain nesceret.

source: Heh… Lumian smirked inwardly, set down his glass, and headed upstairs.
target: Heh… Lumian interiora subridens, vitrem deponens, et ad superiores conclavia perrexit.

source: Trier, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai
target: Trier, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartmentum 702, 9 Rue Orosai

source: “Jenna should be back the day after tomorrow, right?” Franca murmured, standing by the living room window, a bit wistful and fearful.
target: “Jenna postridie redibit, nonne?” submurmuravit Franca, stans iuxta fenestram atrii, paulo desiderans et timens.

source: Her face alternated between light and shadow against the deep night and streetlights, like an enchanting dream.
target: Vultus eius inter lucem et umbram alternabat sub nocte profunda et luminibus viarum, velut somnium incantans.

source: Suddenly, she saw Penitent Baynfel, dressed in black clerical robes and looking like a charred corpse, emerge from the void, holding a letter.
target: Subito, vidit Penitentem Baynfel, indutum in nigris vestimentis clericalibus et quasi cadaver ustum apparens, ex inania emergere, epistulam tenens.

source: A letter?
target: Epistula?

source: Who’s writing to Lumian?
target: Quis ad Lumian scribit?

source: Hmm, Baynfel’s appearance here means messengers can’t locate Morora, even those with special contracts…
target: Hmm, apparit Baynfel hic, quod significat nuntios Mororam reperire non posse, etiam eos cum contractibus specialibus.

source: Franca accepted the letter with a polite smile.
target: Franca epistulam comiter subridens accepit.

source: “Thank you.”
target: “Gratias.”

source: Baynfel nodded, turned, and vanished into the night outside the window.
target: Baynfel annuit, se vertit, et in noctem extra fenestram evanuit.

source: Franca sighed and mumbled, “I wanted to build a relationship and ask you to introduce me to a messenger…”
target: Franca suspiravit et submurmuravit: “Volebam relationem condere et te rogare ut mihi nuntium adduceres…”

source: She raised her right hand, catching a mixed scent of powder, perfume, grass, flowers, and spices from the letter.
target: Dexteram manum levavit, captans mixtum odorem pulveris, unguenti, graminis, florum, et specierum ex epistula.

source: A letter from a woman?
target: Epistula a femina?

source: Franca, entrusted by Lumian, muttered as she opened the letter and read it.
target: Franca, a Lumiano commissa, submurmuravit, dum epistulam aperiebat et legebat.

source: “Not sure if I should call you Monsieur Louis Berry or Monsieur Lumian Lee.
target: “Nescio utrum te appellare debeam “Monsieur Louis Berry” aut “Monsieur Lumian Lee.”

source: “Through Rhea, I’ve delved into Matani’s mysticism circle, learning much about the mysticism and realizing I’m not weak—just inexperienced and unable to show it. For real.
target: “Per Rhea, in circulum mysticismi Matani penitus immeritus sum, multa de mystica didiciens, atque animadvertens me non esse infirmum, sed solum inexperientem et id ostendere non posse. Vere.

source: “Of course, I’ve also realized the gap between us and how vast the world is beyond Matani.
target: “Certe, etiam animadverti spatium inter nos ac quam immensus mundus extra Matani sit.

source: “I’m willing to help your friend and hope you’ll keep your promise.
target: “Parata sum ad auxilium amico tuo ferendum, atque spero te promissionem tuam servare.

source: “Amandina.”
target: Amandina.
